description: This Java class implements a command strategy for processing savings account transactions within a batch processing framework. It extracts URL parameters, determines the command to execute, and delegates the transaction request to the SavingsAccountTransactionsApiResource.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements a batch command for handling savings account transaction requests, delegating to the savings account transactions API resource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a batch request for a savings account transaction, extracting parameters from the URL, invoking the savings account API, and returning the response.
